hypothesis: Previous shadow protection used a stopped-and-rotated reference whose own cash periods conceal market recovery. Separate alpha and risk by retaining passive economic units in the entire supplied technology pool, with an always-observable passive reference even when actual capital is reduced. This also isolates timing value from ex-post leader selection.

rules.reference: same-engine matched buy-and-hold book on supplied symbols only; no absent leaders or external symbols
rules.reduction: reference NAV below its causal exponential mean by hysteresis for confirmation consecutive closes
rules.recovery: reference NAV above its causal exponential mean by hysteresis for confirmation consecutive closes
rules.actual_targets: on a risk transition adopt contemporaneous passive constituent proportions at cap floor or one; otherwise preserve actual economic units, admitting only causal changes in reference holdings; no daily equal-weight rebalance
rules.execution: unchanged cash-only next-open engine, capacity and all fees

selection_objective: mean(log(wealth / matched buy_hold wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20))
caveats: This diagnoses timing, not economic acceptance or universal dominance. All inspected 2026 results remain retrospective. Preserve all trials, real filled orders and original rejected families. Any transition-induced transaction proliferation counts against this policy. No stage or version product names.
